name: Astah SysML
description: A dedicated desktop SysML v1 modeling product with requirements and parametric diagrams, model traceability, compare-and-merge workflows, scripting, and Cameo-oriented exchange.
editorialNote: Added from NeoMBSE's 2026-10-23 coverage audit. Astah SysML is a separate SKU from Astah Professional and Astah System Safety.

xmiExport.note: The official page states OMG XMI 2.5 export; Cameo import uses MDXML or MDZIP.

collaboration.note: Verified for file comparison and merge rather than real-time co-editing.

requirementsManagement.note: Verified for model-level requirements, tables, relationships, and traceability.

classificationNotes: The product currently supports SysML v1; SysML v2 is provided through separate Astah extensions.
MDXML/MDZIP import is not labeled as generic XMI import in this record.
